# Every read registered with the instance console, as
# "contributor intent@version kind capability open|blocked". open means the
# console gate lets a platform admin send it; blocked reads are on
# consoleBlockedQueries in extensions/identity/console_allowlist.go, or are
# Ctrl Plane reads infrastructure.ConsoleRead leaves out. Read
# consoleReadsFile in console_reads_test.go before you add a line or turn
# one to open.
